acceptanceCriteria: A Corvint-shipped RSpec formatter (or documented formatter option) emits shared_group_inclusion_backtrace and the provider records the including file:line instead of not-reported
A real RSpec run (rspec gem installed) proves it, with a fail-without-fix test
body: V1-2010 (PR #1282, LPCV-V0-133) records shared-example provenance as not-reported on stock runs because the stock RSpec JSON formatter omits shared_group_inclusion_backtrace. GitHub #1271 item 3 stays partly unmet. Version: branch claude/ruby-provider-examples-2010 at 39600b79d.
title: Ruby provider: record RSpec shared-example provenance with a formatter that emits shared_group_inclusion_backtrace
